read.thesis: Q2 adj. margin rose 100bp to 11.3% and EPS up 17% on flat sales, but FY sales guide sits at -3.5% to -1.5% organic with battery drag; turbine/data-centre pivot is pre-revenue beyond $300M 2027 target.

triggers.label: Turbine generator $300M revenue 2027
triggers.quote: we've announced we're installing 2 gigawatts of capacity and in the initial year, which is next year, about $300 million of revenue

triggers.label: FY adj. EPS raised to $5.05-5.30
triggers.quote: we are now expecting full year adjusted EPS in the range of $5.05 to $5.30 per diluted share

triggers.label: Turbos & Thermal organic -4.3%
triggers.quote: Turbos & Thermal Technologies Sales -- $1,442 million, representing an organic sales decrease of 4.3% year over year.

triggers.label: Battery sales $100M vs $159M
triggers.quote: Battery Energy Systems Sales -- $100 million in the quarter, a decrease from $159 million in the prior year quarter.

guidance.quote: We continue to project total 2026 sales in the range of $14.0 billion to $14.3 billion
we expect our 2026 organic sales change to be down 3.5% to down 1.5% year-over-year
We continue to expect our full year adjusted operating margin to be in the range of 10.7% to 10.9%
we are now expecting full year adjusted EPS in the range of $5.05 to $5.30 per diluted share
we continue to expect full year free cash flow to be in the range of $900 million to $1.1 billion
we've announced we're installing 2 gigawatts of capacity and in the initial year, which is next year, about $300 million of revenue

red_flags.label: Battery sales down ~37% YoY, FY headwind 170bp
red_flags.quote: we expect a sales decline in our battery business due to the lack of North American incentives and weaker European demand

red_flags.label: Turbo/thermal organic decline
red_flags.quote: Turbos & Thermal Technologies Sales -- $1,442 million, representing an organic sales decrease of 4.3% year over year.

evasions.topic: Turbine generator capacity decision and hyperscaler order size
evasions.quote: Yes, I would say we haven't really disclosed our lead times, and we're not going to talk about that.
I wouldn't say there's any type of rule of thumb. Every data center project is bespoke.
